text: Good Friday at the Holy Trinity Cathedral
Today is Good Friday – the most solemn day of Passion Week. The Orthodox Church commemorates the crucifixion, the deposition from the Cross, and the burial of Jesus Christ.
The Locum Tenens of the Patriarchal Throne, Metropolitan Shio, is officiating the Royal Hours, Vespers, and the bringing out of the Epitaphios (Shroud) at the Holy Trinity Patriarchal Cathedral.

On Good Friday, the Divine Liturgy is not celebrated in churches because, according to the Gospel, the Lord sacrificed Himself to redeem humanity from their sins. During the service, the Royal Hours are performed, during which the Gospel accounts of the Lord's Passion are read.
